steps.text: Preheat the oven at 180 C and preheat for 10 minutes.
Cream the sugar and unsalted butter, noting that powdering the sugar will make the creaming easy.
Add the eggs and vanilla essence to the creamed mixture and mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together all purpose flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
Alternate adding the dry ingredients and milk to the wet mixture and mix until combined.
Place the batter into cupcake liners in a muffin tray to make 18-20 standard cupcakes.
Bake the cupcakes at 180 C for about 20-25 minutes.
